privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.contactUnknown: The team contact could not be loaded. Try again once online.

data.title: Data collected
text: Without an account, your trips are saved on your device only.
With an account: your email address (to send you the sign-in code) and your trips, including the addresses of your accommodation and personal stops.

server.title: Searches and location
text: To prepare a trip, the app sends our servers the places needed for the calculation (destination, accommodation, your location if you allow it). They are not stored as such: our caches and technical logs only keep a rounded position (about 1 km).
Our technical logs contain no email address or street address.
Address search and “Use my location” go through the Photon service (komoot, Germany), with no information about your account.
To prevent abuse, the server keeps an irreversible fingerprint of the IP address for one day, never the IP address itself.

purpose.title: Purpose
text: This data is only used to sign you in and to find your trips on your devices. It is never sold or used for advertising.

hosting.title: Hosting
text: Data is hosted in the European Union (Ireland) by Supabase.

retention.title: Retention
text: Your trips are kept as long as your account exists.
A deleted trip is erased from the server immediately; only a technical marker with no content is kept for 90 days to pass the deletion on to your other devices.

rights.title: Your rights
text: You can delete your account at any time from Settings: your account and all your trips are then erased.
You can also ask to access or correct your data by writing to us.

explainer.title: Get reminders?
text: Mon guide can send you, the evening before, the next day’s programme with the suggested departure time, and a reminder one hour before each stop.
Reminders are scheduled on your phone: they arrive even without a connection.
You can change your mind at any time in Settings.

settings.exactDenied: Exact alarms are not allowed: reminders may arrive a few minutes late.
batteryText: Some manufacturers (Xiaomi, Huawei, Oppo, Samsung…) restrict background apps to save battery, which can delay or block reminders.
To avoid this: phone Settings > Battery (or Apps > Mon guide > Battery), choose “Unrestricted” or “Not optimised”, and allow auto-start if the setting exists.
Reopening Mon guide reschedules missing reminders.
